title: UNITED STATES CORPORATION COMPANY
summary: Citizen-journalist post claiming the 1871 Act created a hidden 'US Inc.' that is bankrupt and being dismantled by a continuity-of-government plan.

assertions.quote: the Act of 1871, which basically created the UNITED STATES CORPORATION COMPANY
just the President of the bankrupted US corporation
a continuity of government (COG) restoration plan was required to take down “US Inc.” and reestablish the USA Republic

verdicts.note: No such plan exists; the 'United States Corporation Company' cited is a private registered-agent firm, not the government.
